question: Is there any rail roughness data for Bethnal Green to Mile End?
norm_question: is there any rail roughness data for bethnal green to mile end

answer.text: In FOI-1730-1819 (published 22 October 2018), a TfL FOI case officer reported elevated rail roughness levels between 720 and 880m on Bethnal Green to Mile End, and the attached plots for eastbound Bethnal Green to Mile End are held here as figure captions only.

verified_claims.text: In FOI-1730-1819 (published 22 October 2018), a TfL FOI case officer stated that rail roughness measurements between Bethnal Green and Mile End showed elevated rail roughness levels between 720 and 880m as the likely cause of noise at the site.

citations.quote: Please provide information regarding monitoring of noise and vibration on the Central Line between Bethnal Green and Mile End.
elevated rail roughness levels between 720 and 880m which are the likely cause of the noise at this site.

verified_claims.text: The rail roughness plots attached to FOI-1730-1819 (published 22 October 2018) cover Eastbound Bethnal Green to Mile End across 30-100mm and 100-300mm bands for LHR and RHR (Figures 1 to 4), and the text held in our corpus is figure captions only; no roughness data is held for the westbound direction.
